description: List workflows (multi-step automations) in a workspace, newest first, with their triggers, whether each is active, its step count and its last run. Call get_workflow on one for its steps and the order a run takes them.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: list_workflows

id.description: Workflow UUID, the workflow_id other workflow tools take.

status.description: pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

last_run.description: A recent run, or null if the workflow has never run.

trigger_type.description: The first trigger's type: manual, schedule, webhook, vercel_event, github_event, cursor_event, linear_event, slack_event or figma_event. See triggers for all of them.

triggers.description: Everything that starts a run of this workflow, in order.

entry_step_id.description: The step this trigger starts a run at; null is the start step.

trigger_config.description: Trigger settings, e.g. { cron, timezone } for a schedule. A webhook's signing secret is never returned: the webhook URL and secret are in the workflow's settings in the Stunt Double dashboard.

title: List workflows
